messages:
Taylor: Heads up team — first 24h after launch and we just crossed 100k signups! :tada: :confetti_ball:
Morgan: WHAT. that's insane. virtual parade? or hat relay in the office? :top_hat: :running_man:
BuildBot: Launch metrics snapshot:
```
new_signups_24h: 100,423
peak_rps: 9.7
avg_resp_ms: 68
errors_5xx_24h: 1
active_instances: 29
```
Lee: i'll coordinate hats. low-key relay across the kitchen at 11:30. someone bring a stopwatch. :stopwatch: :kitchen:
Chris: i'll DJ a 90s hype playlist. requests welcome. also bringing silly foam finger. :musical_note: :hand_point_up:
Dana: remote folks — i'll set up a "hat cam" and a Slack call so you get the chaos. join at 11:30 PT. :computer: :camera_with_flash:
Priya: sticker idea: "I helped ship it" with a tiny rocket + party hat. yes/no? react :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:.
Riley: vote: :thumbsup: for hat rocket, :heart: for server rack sticker.
Taylor: huge shoutout to infra for the pre-launch autoscale rules. before that tweak we'd have been on the floor. :rocket: @BuildBot you are a legend.
BuildBot: Logged event: milestone/100k_signups by Taylor at 1954321000 to /events/milestones.json
Morgan: catering check: @Lee can you do snacks that are clearly labelled? i will handle cup options and forks. no cross-contamination pls. :apple: :fork_and_knife:
Lee: noted. vegan and nut-free options included. also gluten-free cookie option. :cookie:
Chris: GIF to commemorate: <https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-100k-launch|https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-100k-launch>
Dana: remote folks drop your desk-hat selfies in this thread. winner gets a sticker + mystery snack shipped. :camera: :package:
Priya: quick 2-min huddle after the hats to share learnings and then back to support rotation. tiny celebration, then steady. proud of everyone. :heart: :clinking_glasses:
